scope: fallback selection only; the selected three-route automatic acceptance set and each accepted decision are immutable

inputs.features: route_features output joined by normalized path and candidate_index
inputs.auto_policy: three_route_auto selected_policy supplied as a frozen input

feature_firewall: Rules may read only route predictions and non-truth features: candidate color/corners/tilt, image pixel gray mean, candidate/layout lengths, and fallback A/M route outputs/confidences.
Rules may not read truth, subset, category, filename brightness, truth plate_color, split membership, or evaluation correctness.
filename brightness may be used only to report the dark subgroup metric, never to choose a route.

split.path_order: normalize separators to '/', Unicode-preserving casefold, then sort by normalized path before shuffling
split.shuffle: one Python-compatible Random(42) stream; traverse groups by (fixed_split, subset) lexical order and shuffle each group's sorted rows
split.fit_hold: first floor(n/2) shuffled rows are fit; remainder are hold; all current groups are even

fallbacks.L: production legacy S/R decision: first per-candidate/rect legacy S/R OK under archived default thresholds; if none, use the existing agreement_then_reader fallback. It is only a fallback text source for images rejected by the selected three-route auto gate; retain the rejected auto result's non-OK/NO_READ status so L cannot enlarge the accepted set
fallbacks.decision: Only choose which already-computed A, M, or L fallback result to return. If the chosen fallback has no result, use the other available fallback in A, M, L order. Never change an automatic accepted result.
fallbacks.status: A legal fallback output is LOW_CONFIDENCE; if no fallback is legal, retain BAD_INPUT or emit NO_READ. These evaluator labels are not a production runtime mapping; architecture integration maps no-read to SEG_FAILED and preserves existing special-color/error handling.

selection.eligibility: fit val/ccpd_green correct >= max(ceil(0.926*n), fit val/ccpd_green correct under production legacy baseline L)
selection.hold: Do not score any rule on hold until the selected id is frozen. Then report only selected, A, M, and L on hold once.
selection.full_set: After selection and hold report, report selected, A, M, and L on all fixed rows; this is descriptive and does not alter the choice.
selection.auto_set: Validate globally that the supplied automatic policy meets 99.5% precision on val and devhard; fallback selection must preserve exact per-row automatic status/plate/confidence/route/candidate/rect.
